_comment: Workspace-specific channel wiring for the organizer audit. Edit this file, not the script.
RULE — NEVER AUTO-MAP AN ALIAS. Every entry below is a human judgement that a named
channel really is that chapter's channel, and only a human may add one. An agent that
spots a likely match must PROPOSE it and wait for confirmation; it must not write the
entry itself, and it must not widen the matcher to guess. The audit is allowed to say
'no channel found' — that is a correct, recoverable answer. A wrong alias is not: it
reports a chapter as covered when it has no room, and nothing downstream re-checks it.
'public' maps a chapter city to the channel that is genuinely ITS OWN channel, where the
name breaks the plain-slug convention. A city not listed here is matched automatically by
slug (and by the prefixes in 'public_prefixes'). Map a city to null to record that no
channel exists and stop the matcher guessing.
'regional' maps a city to a channel that SERVES it without being its own — #india for
Chennai, #africa for Lagos. These are reported as 'regional only', never counted as
chapter coverage, because a member there has no local room.
